footer: You're receiving this because of activity on your Kept account. Manage notifications in Account → Notifications.

details.online: Online — the link will be shared by the business

booked.title: You're booked with {business}
booked.subject: Confirmed: {service} with {business}
booked.heading: Your appointment is confirmed
booked.footnote: Need to change plans? You can reschedule or cancel from the appointment page, subject to the business's policy.
booked.sms: Kept: {service} with {business} is confirmed for {when}. Ref {reference}

requested.title: Request sent to {business}
requested.body: We'll let you know as soon as they respond.
requested.subject: Request sent: {service} with {business}
requested.heading: Your request has been sent
requested.paragraph: {business} reviews requests before confirming. We'll email you as soon as they respond.

bizBooked.title: New booking
bizBooked.subject: New booking: {service}
bizBooked.heading: You have a new booking
bizBooked.requestHeading: You have a new booking request
bizBooked.requestParagraph: Approve or decline it from your calendar. Unanswered requests expire automatically.

cancelled.refund: A refund of {amount} is on its way to your original payment method.
cancelled.bookAgain: You can book another time whenever you're ready.

rescheduled.title: {business} moved your appointment
rescheduled.subject: New time: {service} with {business}
rescheduled.heading: Your appointment has a new time
rescheduled.changeIt: If the new time doesn't work, you can reschedule or cancel from the appointment page.

approvedPay.title: {business} accepted your request
approvedPay.subject: Accepted — confirm your {service}
approvedPay.heading: Your request was accepted
approvedPay.paragraph: Pay the {amount} deposit to lock in your time. Unpaid bookings are released automatically.

reminder.title: Reminder: {service} {lead}
reminder.subject: Reminder: {service} {lead} at {time}
reminder.heading: See you {lead}
reminder.footnote: Running late or can't make it? Let the business know from the appointment page.

review.title: How was {service}?
review.subject: How was your visit to {business}?
review.heading: How did it go?
review.paragraph: Your review helps {business} and others choosing a professional. It takes less than a minute.

waitlist.title: A spot opened at {business}
waitlist.body: {when} is now available. Book quickly — first come, first served.
waitlist.subject: A time opened up at {business}
waitlist.heading: Good news — a time opened up
waitlist.paragraph: {when} just became available. Spots are first come, first served, so book soon if it works for you.

verify.subject: Confirm your email
verify.preheader: One tap to confirm your email address.
verify.heading: Welcome, {name}
verify.paragraph: Confirm your email so businesses can reach you about your appointments.
verify.footnote: This link expires in 3 days. If you didn't create an account, you can ignore this email.

reset.subject: Reset your password
reset.heading: Reset your password
reset.paragraph: Someone (hopefully you) asked to reset the password for your Kept account.
reset.footnote: This link expires in 1 hour. If you didn't ask for this, you can safely ignore this email — your password won't change.

invite.subject: {inviter} invited you to join {business} on Kept
invite.heading: Join {business}
invite.paragraph: {inviter} invited you to join the team at {business}. You'll be able to see your schedule and manage your appointments.
invite.reminderFootnote: This invitation expires in {days} days. Earlier invitation links no longer work.
